what: A compass dial with 26 ticks (rounded bars) around a circle. While the cursor is over the plate, the dial follows the unit direction from center toward the cursor with .4s power2.out, and only ticks within 80° of that direction thicken from width 8 to 55 in proportion to cos. When the cursor leaves the plate, it settles in .8s. The whole tick plate swings ±5° over 6s sine.inOut. On touch devices the thick side turns on its own once every 5s.

options.min-w · max-w: Tick width 8 → 55 (viewBox units = Diameter in px)
options.length: Tick length, 11% of default board size

note: Attach the cursor listener to this element — to react across the whole panel, make the dial as large as the panel or attach it to the panel. The original also drew a circle (radius 418)·crosshairs·N/E/S/W letters, but the part only has ticks — letters·lines differ per section
